title: Thank you all!
content: I have been in the mall for 60+ years. Earliest dream memories. Some memories can be recollected others vague, but I remember being in the mall. Have you been in the earth under the mall? Very interesting down there. Fucking vivid memory of meeting someone who I believe was Hephaestus and his beautiful wife. He was not a cripple as we might think of it. He is so powerful that it cripples him, much like Autism. When he focuses, especially on you, his power is great and his golden eyes behold you in totality. He can give gifts. Sometimes when in the mall my dreams are what some might term nightmares, but they do not affect me as such, the are gory, odd, powerful or ludicrous, but always impactful. I like the escalators, elevators, walkways and other odd means of conveyance. I have worked there in many strange ways. Had lovers, teachers, people who were Important at the time. Friends from the waking world playing parts in the dream, but often not themselves. #1 place to dream!
